metadata.title: Secure Application Operations SSPP
metadata.remarks: Defines operational responsibilities for sustaining secure application behavior over time. This SSPP governs monitoring, coordination, and escalation of application trust conditions while explicitly excluding authority, authorization logic, and incident response.

import-profile.remarks: Application operations derive authority from Secure Application Authority SSPP and coordinate enforcement across Platform and Relying Systems SSPPs. This SSPP SHALL NOT redefine application behavior or risk ownership.

pattern-bindings.remarks: Implements operational aspects of application observability and governance required to sustain trust over time.
Supports continued assertion of the Trusted Application composite by preserving observability, integrity, and escalation pathways.

system-characteristics.system-description: Operational processes and capabilities supporting the sustained trust of institutional applications.

system-implementation.remarks: Application operations SHALL ensure continued observability, correctness, and escalation of application trust conditions. Operations SHALL coordinate but SHALL NOT make trust, authorization, or risk acceptance decisions.

components.description: Operational functions supporting collection, retention, and availability of application telemetry and audit evidence.
Coordination mechanisms for deployment, runtime support, and change activity affecting application trust assumptions.

roles.title: Application Operations
roles.remarks: Operates applications in accordance with approved trust constraints and ensures continuous availability of observability signals.

roles.title: Application Operations Oversight
roles.remarks: Verifies that operations preserve application trust guarantees and escalate deviations appropriately.

operational-requirements.statement: Application operations SHALL ensure that required telemetry, logs, and decision traces remain continuously available for governance and oversight.
Operational changes affecting application runtime, dependencies, or configuration SHALL be coordinated to preserve application trust assumptions.
Operations SHALL preserve application trust signals and SHALL NOT modify, filter, or suppress evidence of application behavior.

prohibited-operational-actions.statement: Application operations SHALL NOT interpret or override application authorization, policy, or business logic.
Application operations SHALL NOT accept, normalize, or conceal application trust risk.
Operations SHALL NOT silently remediate trust violations without escalation and governance awareness.

escalation-requirements.statement: Detected violations of application trust guarantees SHALL escalate for governance and security review.

control-implementation.description: Operational controls ensure application trust is preserved, observable, and escalated without collapsing authority boundaries.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Continuous monitoring supports operational awareness of application trust conditions.
Audit records are available for review and investigation.
Operational changes are tracked and coordinated to prevent unintended trust degradation.

statements.statement: Application operations SHALL preserve observability, authority boundaries, and evidence under all conditions.
Operational continuity SHALL NOT justify weakening application trust guarantees.
Trust violations SHALL escalate rather than self-resolve.

back-matter.remarks: This SSPP completes the Secure Application SSPP family. High-assurance or environment-specific overlays MAY further constrain operations but SHALL NOT weaken these requirements.
